mapper.select: select c.comment_seq, c.board_seq, c.member_seq, c.content, m.name as writer_name, to_char(c.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, to_char(c.moddate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as moddate from tbl_board_comment c join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = c.member_seq where c.board_seq = #{boardSeq} and c.enabled = 'Y' order by c.comment_seq
select comment_seq, board_seq, member_seq, content, enabled from tbl_board_comment where comment_seq = #{commentSeq} and enabled = 'Y'
